engineMapping.sanchenSuccess: Actual nonempty discarded cards have pairwise distinct effective categories. One or two cards can satisfy this text; zero actual cards earns no bonus/refund. Actual game activation remains counted even when the phase use is refunded.
engineMapping.targetPrerequisite: Other living character with at least one actual hand card, because the real effect must reveal a hand entity; revalidate on effect entry and use the native skip if no card remains.
engineMapping.unexpectedAssaultChoice: Caster uses the existing private opaque target-hand slot child. The selected actual card is then publicly revealed and stays in hand.
engineMapping.damage: If the frozen use suit is not None and differs from the selected card's current effective suit, issue one ordinary damage point attributed to the actual native use source. Native Nullification applies before any reveal. No additional discard cost.
engineMapping.pochuCompletion: Freeze accepted conversion source and policy at declaration; settle whole-use actual damage once. No damage disables the stable owner's skill for the actual turn even after physical loss/regrant; natural physical uses have no skill-disable policy.

ruleCorrectionsFromCurrentPrimary: Self-target is excluded by both Target and current description.
The UnexpectedAssault use itself must have a suit. None/None and None/colored deal no damage; a suited use versus a colorless hand card has different suits and can deal damage.
A current effective suit is compared, using the frozen accepted cost's effective suit for the conversion rather than a post-movement printed suit.
The current formal text contains no additional matching-suit discard payment.
